name: Team Squirtle: Subterranean Deluge & Electric Surge
archetype: Hydro artillery, Electric speed sweeping, and Ground/Fighting physical breaker.
gym_duel_rationale: Super Nerd Miguel's fossil forces face torrential water artillery and electric counters: Blastoise/Fearow leads at Cap 63 to douse Kabutops/Omastar, Tyrantrum/Dragonite, and Aerodactyl with massive STAB Hydro Pump artillery; Jolteon/Sandslash shocks Aerodactyl and Tyrantrum/Dragonite with Discharge while Earthquake crumbles Aron/Sableye; Arbok/Primeape applies Intimidate to curb Aerodactyl's Stone Edge on switch-in and crushes steel hybrids with Close Combat; Alakazam/Weezing dismantles Lairon/Medicham with STAB Psychic while Levitate dodges Ground moves; and Snorlax walls special hits with Rest and Leftovers.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid anchored at Cap 63. STAB Hydro Pump douses Kabutops/Omastar, Tyrantrum/Dragonite, and Aerodactyl cleanly.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate grants Ground immunity. STAB Psychic dismantles Lairon/Medicham.
486 BST speed sweeper. Discharge electrocutes Tyrantrum/Dragonite and Aerodactyl. STAB Earthquake crumbles Aron/Sableye.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Aerodactyl's Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat delivers massive damage to steel foes.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray fossil attacks comfortably, resetting damage with Rest and Sleep Talk.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly freezes Tyrantrum/Dragonite and Aerodactyl across deep ruins.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
